en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large guesthouse or sanatorium-style building in a forested valley. In the foreground there is a path with a simple railing following a small stream, and a narrow bridge leading to the building. The structure has a tiled roof, timber-framed gable, and several trees and benches in front. Printed German text at the top identifies the place as Bärenfels in the Saxon Ore Mountains and names the establishment "Erholungsheim 'Waldwiese'". A small sign near the bridge also refers to the Erholungsheim.
